description:
In GTA 6, the money you steal is worthless until you launder it. That's the least strange thing Rockstar told the YouTubers they flew to Rockstar North — and this week the Italian creator's notes finally got translated into English. Here's the second wave of GTA 6 gameplay details: store robberies with hidden safes, dirty money and money laundering, cops that warn you before they shoot, the six-star question Rob Nelson refused to answer, body fat and sleep quality as actual stats, Lucia's off-screen routine, and the Jason and Lucia relationship system — including the fact that they can break up.

Chapters 0:00 The money you steal is worthless 0:45 Robbing a store in GTA 6 is a heist now (hidden safes, police perimeter) 2:00 Dirty money and money laundering in GTA 6 3:05 Cops warn before they shoot + what happens at six stars 4:20 Body fat and sleep quality are real stats (gym 3x a week) 5:30 Lucia has a life without you (off-screen routines) 5:55 The couple icon: split up to lose the cops 6:10 Rockstar didn't want a "nagging" relationship 6:35 Tell her or hide it — the relationship consequences 7:05 Jason and Lucia can break up 7:30 The one thing Rockstar refused to put in GTA 6

Sources

Rob Nelson (Rockstar North co-studio head) via Mike ShowSha's Rockstar North preview, translated by u/El_Pintor64 and covered by TGG: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=81lxnmTNH_M

Rob Nelson to IGN on Jason and Lucia staying "partners in crime" and on satire: https://www.pcgamer.com/games/grand-theft-auto/rockstar-has-to-be-careful-about-what-gta-6-picks-to-satirize-because-very-specific-political-issues-or-memes-will-date-fast/
Insider Gaming on the break-up mechanic: https://insider-gaming.com/gta-6-will-let-jason-and-lucia-break-up/

GTA VI: An Extended Look (Rockstar Games): https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/9k2kaa1o3297k9/grand-theft-auto-vi-an-extended-look Everything in this video is what Rockstar said or what creators who watched the game being played reported. Where only one source has said something, I say so in the video.


GTA 6 releases November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Standard Edition $79.99, Ultimate Edition $99.99.

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAutoVI #Rockstar

comments.text:
Thumbnail: You can't steal money.
Description: The money you steal...

I knew this would be click bait. 

"You can't put it in a bank"

Why would a known criminal on the run from the law put their stolen money in a bank?  'Yeah, I don't have a job but I'd like to deposit a few hundred thousand dollars.'

"blow the safe up, risking burning some of the money so you'll get less loot. How crazy is that?" 

That's risk and reward. If you spend time searching for the code, you have a greater risk of getting caught but your reward for succeeding is equally greater. If you do it the quickest way possible, the risk of getting caught is lower but you get a smaller reward. It's a very simple concept that has been around for a long time and is proven to be a good thing. I've never heard anyone act as though it's somehow a bad thing until now. I mean, what would you prefer instead? The best possible reward for the least amount of effort? How crazy is that?
